headline: Yutaka Giken Co., Ltd. Details Cyber Incident in Regulatory Filing
body: In a recent regulatory filing, Yutaka Giken Co., Ltd. provided details of a cybersecurity incident that temporarily halted operations. The automotive components supplier reported that a malware infection spread during a routine tool installation, affecting thousands of machines. The company has since restored its systems and resumed production. Yutaka Giken Co., Ltd. estimates a modest single-digit-percentage impact on revenue and has engaged incident response teams to strengthen its cybersecurity posture.
